items.html: And it is found that she now has a Partzuf of only her upper nine Sefirot; and this was on all the Shabbatot, and also on weekdays, when she would return with him back to back, from the chest and below, she had only a Partzuf of her upper nine Sefirot, included in the measure of the stature of his four lower [Sefirot], because her Malchut, which is the first firmament, had departed from there and ascended into the Yesod.
